fields.name: record_id
fields.description: Stable unique identifier for one extracted record.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Identifier linking the record to specs/source_map.json.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Source category: scientific_paper, database, or web_page.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: URL for web/database source or DOI landing page when available.

fields.name: source
fields.description: DOI, URL, or textual source reference.

fields.name: source_location
fields.description: Page, table, figure, section, or DNAmoreDB entry page location.

fields.name: sensor_architecture
fields.description: Broad sensor architecture, e.g. DNAzyme_cascade, BiDZ, DNM, MB-DNS.

fields.name: dnazyme_name
fields.description: DNAzyme, probe, or sensor component name.

fields.name: full_sensor_sequence
fields.description: Full multicomponent sequence annotation when available, stored as component_name=sequence pairs.

fields.name: target_name
fields.description: Target, analyte, RNA/DNA fragment, or biological target description.

fields.name: target_sequence
fields.description: Target/analyte sequence or substrate description when available.

fields.name: target_type
fields.description: Broad target class such as synthetic_DNA, total_RNA, viral_RNA, bacterial_RNA_proxy.

fields.name: reaction_type
fields.description: Underlying reaction such as RNA_cleavage or peroxidase-like oxidation.

fields.name: detection_method
fields.description: Readout method: fluorescence, colorimetric, database_metadata, etc.

fields.name: measurement_type
fields.description: Measurement type such as LOD, detectable_concentration, sensitivity_improvement_factor, metadata_only.

fields.name: measurement_value
fields.description: Numeric value as reported or extracted, when applicable.

fields.name: measurement_unit
fields.description: Original measurement unit, e.g. nM, pM, ng/uL, fold.

fields.name: normalized_value_nM
fields.description: Measurement value converted to nanomolar for concentration units when possible.

fields.name: lod_nM
fields.description: LOD converted to nanomolar for LOD records when possible.

fields.name: signal_to_background_ratio
fields.description: Signal-to-background ratio if explicitly reported.

fields.name: temperature_c
fields.description: Assay temperature in degrees Celsius.

fields.name: Gibbs_energy
fields.description: Gibbs energy descriptor if available.

fields.name: buffer
fields.description: Assay buffer composition.

fields.name: pH
fields.description: Assay pH.

fields.name: Mg_mM
fields.description: Magnesium concentration in mM.

fields.name: Na_mM
fields.description: Sodium concentration in mM.

fields.name: fluorophore
fields.description: Fluorophore label if reported.

fields.name: quencher
fields.description: Quencher label if reported.

fields.name: extraction_method
fields.description: pdf_manual, pdf_table_manual, web_html_entry_page, etc.

fields.name: extraction_confidence
fields.description: high, medium, low, or unknown.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Manual curation notes, caveats, and provenance.
